title: cam-worker image ships Node 18; knip needs 22+, dead-code gate is blind in-container
description: The dead-code gate of the quality spine (bunx knip, scripts/check-all.ts:87) crashes inside the cam-worker container: knip's bundled colors.js imports styleText from node:util, available only on Node 22+, and the container has Node 18.20.4 because .devcontainer/Dockerfile:14 installs nodejs npm from the Debian slim apt repo (still 18.x). The failure is at import time, before knip reads any source file; it reproduces identically on a clean checkout with no diff. Observed 2026-07-06 during the CAM-118 cycle: the implementer documented it in handoff.json on US-001 and carried it to US-002; typecheck, test, lint, embed-vendor, file-size, debt-markers, coverage, dup and ci-parity all stayed green, only dead-code fails. Impact: workers in container isolation cannot run the full check:all spine, so a real dead-code violation surfaces only late, at ship time (the deterministic ship runner executes check:all on the host, Node 25, where knip works) or in CI, instead of as a cheap intra-story fix; recurring risk that workers habituate to treating a check:all failure as an environment gap, weakening gate discipline (degrades the CAM-59 green-local equals green-CI contract inside the container). Fix: install Node 22 LTS in the Dockerfile (NodeSource setup or pinned binary) instead of the Debian default nodejs, then rebuild the image with --no-cache (the CAM-192 mtime-staleness gotchas apply: a cached rebuild does not update the image Created timestamp). Verify with docker exec cam-worker node --version showing 22.x and bunx knip completing in-container.
